audience: environmental programme managers and scientific reviewers
primary_question: Which generalized training sites have sufficient seasonal evidence for review?
legend_requirement: text labels plus colour; no colour-only encoding
interaction_requirement: select a site to read status, count, value, date and limitation
accessible_alternative: monitoring_summary.csv rendered as a labelled HTML table with the same public records
mobile_requirement: primary question, legend, controls and selected-site text remain usable at 320 CSS pixels
provenance_requirement: synthetic status, data date, method summary, licence, attribution and limitations remain visible outside popups
